_doc: DESKTOP-TARGET translation table — the SAME extracted routine.json program (14 actions, same seq order) deployed on REAL desktop apps: real Microsoft Excel (win32com), the real frontiertechy form (Playwright, submit never clicked) and a REAL Gmail compose at the end (default browser; the HUMAN clicks Send = approval gate). Excel actions live inside the spreadsheet; web actions live here. From-excel fields feed the form straight from the workbook cells, so the copy that Act 10 performs in routine.json is the exact value Act 11/13 paste. First/Last name are static demo strings in the map; Personal Number comes from cell A2; Designation + Duty Station receive the copied Row value (B2), which is why the routine copies it TWICE (seq 10 and 12).

mail._doc1: ROBOT-SEND (primary): set smtp_user and a 16-char Gmail App Password here. The robot sends via SMTP, no browser login scene. Leave the password as PUT-... to use the fallback.
mail._doc2: Fallback: blank/placeholder app password or --human-send opens Gmail compose in the default browser; a human clicks Send.
mail._doc3: SECURITY: use a DEMO-ONLY Gmail account with 2FA enabled. Never commit a real App Password. Rotate any password that was ever used in a live demo.
